ideas.label: Two Weaknesses
ideas.principle: Stretch the defense across two fronts
ideas.summary: One weakness can often be defended. Create or attack a second weakness far away so the defender cannot coordinate against both.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Maneuvering: The Art of Piece Play

ideas.label: Two Weaknesses
ideas.summary: Fix the first target before switching wings. Calm improving moves and prophylaxis force passive defense, making the later transfer of king and pieces more effective.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Maneuvering: The Art of Piece Play

ideas.label: Two Weaknesses
ideas.summary: When a kingside pawn is already weak, provoke a queenside pawn into becoming a second target. Keep rooks on the board if exchanging them would let the king defend both weaknesses comfortably, and centralize your king before switching fronts.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927
